review_candidates.title: IT System Administrator
review_candidates.description: Are you looking for more than a job? At World Vision Canada we offer challenging careers that change the lives of children all over the world and it will change yours too. Come and be part of a team of 400 Canadians with a vision for the world: Life in all its fullness for every child. You will experience Christian faith in action helping to make real and lasting change in the lives of the world’s most vulnerable children. Join the World Vision Canada team and be part of a powerful and effective force for good: For Children. For Change. For Life. Position: IT System Administrator Reports to: Manager, Technology Services Position Term: Full Time Permanent Primary Location: Mississauga, Ontario, Canada Workplace Type: Hybrid Job Purpose We are seeking an experienced and motivated IT System Administrator to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in hybrid identity (Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID), Microsoft 365, endpoint management, virtual machines, storage area networks (SAN), enterprise networking and security, and cloud services, with experience in the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe). The IT System Administrator, Technology Services is an integral member of the Technology Services team and is responsible for the technical operations of key World Vision Canada IT systems, spanning on-premises infrastructure and Microsoft 365 / Azure cloud services. A problem-solver at their core, they will work directly with other functional areas to maintain and optimize the integrations of the ecosystem and the data that passes from one system to another. As an IT System Administrator, you will ensure the smooth, secure, and efficient operation of our organization’s IT infrastructure while achieving key performance metrics. This is a hybrid role, largely remote, requiring approximately 20% of time spent in office. The ideal candidate is located in the GTA. Responsibilities Manage and support hybrid identity across Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, Windows Server 2016–2022 environments, and Exchange 2016 / Exchange Online in a hybrid configuration. Administer and support endpoint management systems, including Microsoft Intune, Entra ID device management, Autopilot, and Group Policy. Manage and maintain virtual server environments (VMware and Azure), including installation, configuration, and maintenance. Manage, monitor, and optimize performance of storage area networks (SAN) and cloud storage. Maintain backups and disaster recovery systems, including regular recovery validation testing. Assist with the day over day operations of the organization’s cybersecurity tooling, including Microsoft Defender XDR (EDR), Darktrace, Microsoft Purview, conditional access, MFA, and patching. Administer network and perimeter infrastructure, including FortiGate firewalls, FortiClient EMS, SSL-VPN with SAML/Entra SSO, and Cisco Meraki switching and wireless. Provide support and administration for cloud applications, including Microsoft 365, email, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Teams. Provide support for corporate applications, including installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting. Maintain the security and integrity of the organization’s IT systems and data. Ensure compliance with organizational standards and regulations, such as PCI DSS. Collaborate with other teams to optimize and improve the efficiency of systems and applications, using the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) as a guide. Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and recommend solutions that align with the organization’s goals and objectives. Track and report on key system performance metrics, including uptime, response time, and customer satisfaction. Support projects to optimize current system processes to scale for growth, efficiency, and automation. Update and maintain system architecture diagrams and documentation. Develop and implement IT policies and procedures. Equip Tier 1 and Tier 2 support staff with the information required to handle entry-level system tickets. Deploy production updates during scheduled maintenance windows, largely after-hours. Updates include, but are not limited to, .NET (IIS), CRM, AD schema updates, and firewall/network changes. Collaborate with other teams and vendors to ensure World Vision Canada’s standards are being met. Cross-train, guide, and equip other members of the Technology Services team to ensure organizational stability and flexibility. Provide after-hours support in the event of an outage of any of WVC’s critical systems, or for project-based work, deployments, or maintenance to WVC’s infrastructure. Qualifications BSc in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent in training and experience. 5 years’ work experience in an IT administrative capacity. Experience working with: Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID (hybrid identity), and Windows Server Exchange and Microsoft 365 Endpoint management (Microsoft Intune) Virtual machines (VMware and Azure) SAN solutions and/or cloud storage, and backup / disaster recovery Strong communication (written & verbal) and interpersonal skills. The final offer will reflect the successful candidate’s background and demonstrated capabilities. We bring life-saving support in times of disaster. We help poor communities to take charge of their futures. We provide small loans and training that boost family livelihoods. We work with policy makers to change the way the world is run. We have strong recruitment procedures to make sure the safest and most suitable people work with the children in our programs. We provide our staff and volunteers with ongoing supervision, support and training in their work with child and adult beneficiaries. Thank you for your interest; however only those applicants selected for an interview will be contacted.

Familiarity with Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and hybrid cloud infrastructure Experience developing automation and administrative scripts using PowerShell, Python, or similar tools Industry certifications such as Security+, Network+, CCNA, Microsoft Certified, VMware Certified Professional (VCP), or equivalent Active U.S. Secret Security Clearance or the ability to obtain one What You'll Get Ownership – Manage and secure the enterprise infrastructure that enables spacecraft development and mission operations Innovation – Support advanced IT and cybersecurity technologies powering next-generation aerospace programs Impact – Help protect and maintain the mission-critical systems supporting national security, civil, and commercial space missions Growth – Join a collaborative team where you'll work alongside world-class engineers while expanding your expertise across enterprise infrastructure, cybersecurity, and cloud technologies Compensation – Competitive salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, generous leave, HSA, 401(k) matching, and equity participation Location: Rockville, MD or Hawthorne, CA Base Salary: $125,000 - $155,000 The salary range for this role is determined based on a variety of factors, including work experience, education, technical expertise, certifications, critical skills, and business needs. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full-time offers and are considered part of Quantum Space's total compensation package. At Rehmann, each and every one of our associates plays a pivotal role in the Firm’s success. When you join our team, you can count on exceptional support, encouragement, and guidance from your colleagues and from leadership. No matter where you want to go in your career, Rehmann can help you get there. Whether you’re in the early stages of your professional journey or you’re further down your path, we’re focused on helping you achieve your goals – whatever they may be. When you join Rehmann, you are part of a culture that Puts People First and aims to help everyone reach their fullest potential. Let us show you all the ways we can Empower Your Purpose. To learn more about Rehmann, visit: https://www.rehmann.com/careers/ Job Description Job Summary: As a Senior Network Engineer, you will be a subject matter expert and the highest point of escalation for the technology you champion. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining high-performing, highly available systems to meet our clients' functional and cost requirements. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience with Fortinet, Watchguard, Cisco, Ruckus, and Microsoft Azure networking technologies and familiarity with offerings from other vendors. As a Senior Network Engineer, you will work closely with our clients to understand their unique needs and provide innovative solutions that align with their business objectives. You will also collaborate with our internal teams to ensure the smooth delivery of projects and provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior team members. Essential Duties/Responsibilities Project-Based Implementations: Perform IT project work for clients, designing and implementing on-premises networking systems as well as co-hosted and cloud networking. Systems Architecture: Design, implement, and maintain high-performing, highly available, and secure network systems including but not limited to switching, routing, firewall, cloud networking, and wireless. Research and Development: Assist in researching and developing potential new offerings that can be delivered through our business models. Actively participate in the evaluation of new technology to enhance our service portfolio and develop implementation plans to add new tech to our stack. Presales Support: Provide presales consultation to business advisors and account managers, including reviewing existing client environments and recommending upgrades or changes. Service Request Management: Efficiently manage service requests, ensuring accurate and detailed updates, including next steps. Schedule, research, resolve, and route service requests as appropriate, escalating based on established processes and timeframes. Time Tracking and Billing: This is a billable role, and time entry and accurate tracking of billable work for clients is critical to our success. Time is entered in our PSA system on tickets and projects and notes must be professional and accurate. Troubleshooting: Provide remote and on-site troubleshooting, utilizing appropriate tools to diagnose and remediate issues with client systems. Ensure compliance with service level agreements (SLAs) and operation level agreements (OLAs) while adhering to established best practices. Organization: Demonstrate a high level of organization, efficiently handling a variety of tasks and responsibilities while maintaining a high standard of quality. Flexibility: Exhibit the ability to adapt quickly to new topics, technology, and processes to address emerging IT needs and opportunities for our clients. Work schedule may require conformity to client needs and outcomes. Security and Compliance: Implement and maintain robust security measures to protect client data and systems from unauthorized access, breaches, and cyber threats. When applicable, ensure compliance with relevant industry standards and regulations, such as NIST, GDPR, HIPAA, and PCI-DSS. Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity: Develop and maintain disaster recovery and business continuity plans for clients' systems. Regularly test and update these plans to ensure their effectiveness in the event of an incident. Performance Monitoring and Optimization: Evaluate systems by monitoring system performance, identifying bottlenecks, and implementing optimizations to improve efficiency and reliability. Utilize monitoring tools and analytics to proactively address potential issues before they impact clients. Vendor Management: Liaise with third-party vendors and service providers to ensure seamless integration of their solutions with clients' systems. Communication: Demonstrate excellent communication skills, effectively conveying technical concepts to individuals with varying levels of computer expertise. Ability to explain complex technical concepts in layman's terms is essential. Teamwork: Actively participate in regular team meetings and status update meetings, fostering a collaborative and supportive team environment. Documentation: Document client environments and technical processes, procedures, and solutions for knowledge sharing and future reference. Assist in the creation of user guides, training materials, and technical documentation. On-Call Rotation: Participate in on-call rotation to provide emergency support and resolve critical issues outside of regular business hours. Uphold Rehmann Values: Put people first, be obsessed with client success, cultivate business wisdom, embrace an entrepreneurial spirit, exhibit unwavering integrity. Other duties as assigned to meet client and organizational goals. Required Skills/Abilities Education: High school diploma required. Degree in Computer Information Systems, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent work experience) required. Certifications: Relevant vendor certifications such as Fortinet’s FCP or FCSS, Cisco’s CCNP or CCNA, Microsoft Certified: Azure Network Engineer Associate, and/or other vendor certifications are highly desirable. Proven experience designing and implementing robust, scalable, secure, and high-performance networks that meet the unique needs of various clients. Extensive experience with firewalls, wireless access points, routers, switches, and other network technology from leading vendors such as Fortinet, WatchGuard, Ruckus, and Cisco required. In-depth knowledge of Fortinet’s stack preferred, including FortiGate, FortiAP, FortiSwitch, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, and other technology. Strong understanding of network protocols, topologies, and architectures, including TCP/IP, VLAN, VPN, SD-WAN, ZTNA, DHCP, DNS, and routing protocols. Familiarity with cloud networking in Azure and software-based-networking in VMware and Hyper-V environments. Willingness to travel to client sites as needed, and to work outside of regular business hours when required. As such, must have reliable transportation. Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues. Strong project management skills, with the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously. Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Passion for learning and staying current with emerging technologies and industry trends. Professional certification, such as, OSCP, CEH, PNPT, GPEN, CPTS, eWPT, eWPTX, OSWE, or eCPPT is a plus. Knowledge of programming languages such as Python, GO, C#, C++, or C Understanding of two or more of the following: Active Directory, Cloud Security, Cloud Infrastructure, Web Application Security, and Network Security. Additional Responsibilities Unquestionably sound ethics. Works well in team environment. Excellent written and oral communications skills. Empathy and ability to provide relevant answers suitable to clients/customers at different stages of Services processes. Ability to remain calm and work well under pressure. Manage multiple priorities and deadlines, through disciplined approaches and clear communication. Self-motivated The ability to locate, track, organize and summarize information. Willingness to travel (98% local/state, nationally 2x per year average). Good problem solving and decision-making skills; ability to understand and analyze complex issues. Excellent troubleshooting skills. Adaptable. Able and willing to coach and train others. The ability to build relationships; to ask questions that elicit responses and engage the other in discussion; the ability to introduce and describe relevance at the onset of the engagement and provide summaries to reinforce the message. Sense of humor! How You’ll Make An Impact At Rehmann Assist with vulnerability and penetration testing engagements for clients. Assist with detailed assessments of information technology systems and infrastructures to verify systems are secure and support the related applications or business processes. Evaluating system controls, documenting results, making recommendations, and communicating information to clients. Assist with continuous development and evolution of penetration testing methodology and tool set and web application testing. We Put People First in all that we do. Our associates are our greatest assets and we provide programs and benefits that encourage growth and development and align with their needs and goals. This includes benefits focused on physical and mental health, paid time off for volunteering and diversity-related activities, flexible work arrangements, and more. review_candidates.title: Systems Engineer I
review_candidates.description: Brief Description About Courser Courser accelerates the growth of IT service provider companies. We forge dynamic partnerships, leveraging our values of Teamwork, Service, Growth-Mindedness, Trust, and Innovation to deliver impactful solutions and phenomenal customer experiences. If you thrive in a fast-paced IT environment, join our rapidly expanding team and contribute to our ongoing success. Systems Engineer I A Systems Engineer I is a professional responsible for managing and supporting the IT infrastructure of client organizations within a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment. Their primary role is to ensure the efficient, secure, and reliable operation of systems and networks, provide technical support, and implement solutions that improve the client’s IT environment. The role typically involves working with a wide range of technologies, from networking and servers to security systems and cloud services. Key Responsibilities Provide technical support for client systems, responding to incidents and resolving issues related to hardware, software, networking, and security. Offer solutions to complex IT challenges, ensuring high availability and system performance. Install, configure, and maintain IT infrastructure, including servers, workstations, networks, and software applications for client organizations. Assist with or lead technical projects, such as server migrations, network upgrades, new software implementations, or cloud integrations. Deploy, configure, and manage operating systems (Windows Server, Linux, etc.), virtualization technologies, and cloud services. Monitor and maintain servers, network devices, and other IT infrastructure components. Ensure the optimal performance and uptime of client networks by configuring routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs, and other networking equipment. Troubleshoot and resolve network and server issues, such as connectivity problems, latency, or hardware failures. Implement security best practices, including firewall configurations, antivirus solutions, encryption, and secure authentication mechanisms. Manage vulnerability assessments, patch management, and intrusion detection/prevention systems. Assist in disaster recovery planning and business continuity strategies to minimize downtime during outages. Serve as an escalation point for complex issues that require in-depth technical knowledge. Monitor the health and performance of client networks and systems using monitoring tools (e.g., Nagios, SolarWinds, Datto). Optimize system performance through regular maintenance, updates, and improvements. Proactively identify potential issues and take corrective actions to prevent system failures or performance degradation. Support and manage client cloud services (e.g., Microsoft 365, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and virtualized environments (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V). Assist with cloud migrations, configuration, backup, and restore processes. Ensure the smooth operation of virtual machines, storage, and network configurations in cloud environments. Configure and manage backup solutions for client environments to ensure business continuity. Maintain detailed documentation of client systems, networks, configurations, and service tickets. Provide periodic reports on system performance, uptime, security status, and any incidents or issues addressed. Create and update SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) for common systems and services. Build strong relationships with clients by understanding their needs and providing timely technical solutions. Communicate technical information in an accessible and understandable way to non-technical stakeholders. Participate in regular meetings with clients to discuss IT needs, challenges, and opportunities for improvement. Manage project timelines, resources, and communication to ensure successful and timely project delivery. Work closely with other engineers, technicians, and support teams to resolve client issues and implement solutions. Collaborate with account managers to ensure client satisfaction and effective service delivery. Occasional travel to customer locations may be required to support on-site projects, implementations, or issue resolution. Key Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 2-4 years of experience in systems engineering, IT infrastructure, or a related field, with a strong understanding of system architecture and design principles. Proficiency in operating systems (e.g., Windows, Linux) and virtualization technologies (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V). Strong knowledge of networking concepts, protocols, and security practices (e.g., TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN).
